bio.text: Patrick Callahan represents the 108th House District, which includes New Fairfield, Sherman, New Milford and Danbury, and was first elected in November 2020.
He has lived in New Fairfield for over 25 years and, before his election, served 13 years on the Candlewood Lake Authority (10 as chairman) and on the town's Ethics Committee and Planning Commission.
Callahan worked almost 27 years in criminal justice, as an adult probation officer for 10 years and a chief probation officer for 17, mostly assigned to Danbury Superior Court.
